prompts.background: Create ONE text-free decorative mobile fantasy handbook background asset, 768 x 1664 portrait, for a Roco Kingdom fan handbook. Reference images are visual direction only: borrow only the inviting blue-and-antique-gold UI craft from the first image and the ivory reading surface from the second, NEVER copy or invent any creature or character. Clean, polished 2D mobile game illustration with broad painted shapes and subtle cel-style shading, charming and crisp, no photorealism, no busy AI microtexture. Composition: the top 24% is a beautiful softly lit blue-sky castle courtyard with distant storybook rooftops, rounded clouds, pale stone arches and a little green foliage near the outer edges. Most center and lower 70% becomes a warm light ivory illustrated map/paper reading surface with very faint cartographic lines, gentle paper grain and generous empty space, tiny edge-only botanical flourishes. The upper scenic portion must also work as a cropped background behind separate real character cutouts. Light source upper left, muted navy ink and warm antique-gold accents. No outer phone/device border, no status bar, no panels, no cards, no interface, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no compass icon, no mascots, no faces, no animals, no monsters, no pets, no people, no eggs. This is decorative environment/paper art only, not an official game scene. Fill the whole canvas naturally, no white poster margins. Current project date October 25 2026; show no dates.
prompts.frame: Create ONE reusable TRANSPARENT UI picture-frame asset for a charming 2D fantasy mobile handbook, square 512 x 512. Reference images are visual direction only: use ONLY the tasteful blue and warm antique-gold frame craft, NEVER any depicted creature, icon, text, or scene. Design a continuous slim antique-gold frame with a narrow midnight-blue enamel inner lip, very small rounded bevels, restrained leaf-like metal corner ornaments and tiny corner diamond details. A coherent clean illustrated mobile-game asset: broad readable shapes, subtle cel shading, no photorealism, no heavy 3D extrusion, no excessive glowing crystals, no visual noise. Four corners occupy at most 72 x 72 pixels; edges are straight and quiet so a developer can nine-slice this frame into different rectangular proportions. Transparent opening roughly x=35..477, y=35..477; ornament weight at edges and corners only. No central crest, no top protrusion, no ribbons across the opening. No paper fill, no background texture, no pet, no face, no character, no animal, no book, no words, no letters, no numerals, no mockup, no phone. ONE empty finished frame filling the canvas with just a very small transparent outer margin. It must match a warm ivory paper surface and blue castle scenery. Date anchor Oct 25 2026; no dates shown.

One nameplate only; no collections or examples, no words, no letters, no numbers, no title, no UI screenshots, no device or OS chrome, no faces, no mascots, no creatures. Date anchor Oct 25 2026; no dates shown.
